The application of wireless monitoring technology has verified the monitoring effect of wireless laser ranging and wireless inclination sensors during the construction period. The results show that under timely support conditions, the tunnel structure remains basically safe. For weak stratum tunnels, numerical simulation and backward advanced deep hole grouting pre reinforcement technology are studied to ensure the stability of the soil layer around the tunnel. At the same time, BIM technology is used to construct a tunnel model, visualize the construction process, and develop an intelligent sensing control system for real-time monitoring and risk warning.
authors_display: Hao Wang, Yang Yang, Han Shen

title: Application of Big Data Association Rule Algorithm in Accounting Network Security Monitoring and Accounting System
abstract: In complex environments such as computers, networks, and big data, the integrity and security issues of accounting information have become increasingly prominent. This study analyzes existing vulnerabilities in financial systems to identify specific security and cyber threats that challenge data integrity in the financial industry. In response to the above problems, this paper applies a new network security monitoring technology based on association rules. With the advantages of big data analysis, this traditional monitoring method has been further strengthened, allowing it to better realize real-time monitoring of financial data. Through early detection of security incidents, potential risks are reduced and the normal operation of the accounting system is ensured. Experiments have proven that the enhanced monitoring system has made great improvements in the identification and statistics of network security incidents. There is an average accuracy rate of 95%, which shows that the system is reliable and has the ability to enhance safety measurements. Organically integrate big data technology and traditional network security monitoring methods to form a robust network security protection mechanism.
authors_display: Dongwen Xie

title: 3D Target Detection Algorithm of Laser Point Cloud Based on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Traditional target detection methods based on manual features have limitations, and it is difficult to adapt to complex scenes and various types of targets. Recently, three-dimensional target detection tasks have achieved good performance using artificial intelligence technology that is based on deep learning methods. Based on this, this paper presents a three-dimensional laser point cloud target detection algorithm based on deep learning. First, the point cloud segmentation network is designed for data semantic segmentation of the original point cloud, and the point cloud is categorized in semantic regions. Then, a point cloud region proposal network to generate region proposals according to the categorization results. Finally, the target recognition network of the point cloud is designed to achieve the detection of three-dimensional objects, specifically by conducting proposal classification and position regression. The entire algorithm integrates key modules such as point cloud segmentation, area proposal, and target recognition end-to-end, and fully excavates the geometric characteristics and semantic information of point cloud data. Experimental verification is carried out on the public benchmark data set, and the results show that the proposed algorithm has achieved state-of-the-art performance in the three-dimensional target detection task, and the detection accuracy and recall rate have reached a high level.
authors_display: Xiangyuan Tong, Xiaoyan Huang, Ziyan Li

title: Participation Model for Shared Energy Storage Communities Based on Social Network Analysis
abstract: With the “dual carbon” objective in mind, the expansion of new energy microgrids is anticipated, aiming to create an interconnected multi-microgrid system within a single distribution network, tackling the challenge of efficiently utilizing new energy across multiple microgrids. The unpredictability of new energy is a significant hurdle to its utilization, and energy storage plays a crucial role in mitigating this variability. However, the high cost associated with energy storage can be addressed by implementing shared storage facilities. On one hand, each microgrid develops a multi-objective optimization model designed to reduce net load fluctuations and stabilization expenses through energy storage, identifying their specific storage needs, leasing the necessary storage, and communicating this to the shared storage operator. On the other hand, the shared energy storage operator consolidates the energy storage requirements from all microgrids to deploy a centralized shared storage system. By leveraging the synergistic effects of the combined energy storage needs, the actual energy storage capacity required will be less than the total absolute value of individual microgrid demands, thus creating profit margins for the storage operator and enhancing the efficiency of energy storage resource utilization.
authors_display: Liwei Zhu, Chengjie Jia, Zhenzhong Song, Kai Jiang, Jingling Chen

title: Research on Consumer Behavior and Prediction Based on Deep Learning in the New Energy Vehicle Market
abstract: In recent years, China's new energy vehicles have developed rapidly, but there are significant differences in the motivation of consumers to buy new energy vehicles between restricted/restricted cities and non-restricted/non-restricted cities, which directly affects their decision-making and evaluation in the process of using vehicles. In addition, as joint ventures and foreign brands gradually enter the new energy vehicle market, high-end new energy vehicle consumers will gradually become the main consumers in the future. Therefore, understanding the characteristics of high-end new energy vehicle consumers and tapping their demand for new energy vehicles can provide a reference for enterprises to plan high-end new energy vehicles. Through analysis and comparison, the charging characteristics of different new energy vehicle consumers, as well as the main difficulties and inconveniences in the charging process, on the one hand, provide a reference for new energy vehicle enterprises to understand consumer charging behavior, on the other hand, provide a direction for the improvement and improvement of charging facilities. In addition, while analyzing the current situation of consumer charging, we also further understand their needs and expectations for charging facilities, pointing out the direction for the future layout of charging facilities.
authors_display: Bowen Cai

title: Multi-Objective Optimization of Digital Building Construction Progress under Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the construction progress of digital building projects, this article focuses on the improved genetic algorithm and conducts multi-objective optimization for the construction progress of digital building projects. This article verifies multiple objectives such as project duration, cost, resource utilization, and environmental impact through simulation experiments and multi-objective comprehensive optimization testing experiments in digital construction engineering. In the multi-objective comprehensive optimization testing experiment, the optimization values for the duration, cost, quality, and environment of the digital building project under the algorithm in this paper are 83, 89, 93, and 78. The maximum optimization values for the duration, cost, quality, and environment of an idealized digital construction project are 85, 90, 95, and 80. It can be seen that the quality, duration, cost, environment, and other objectives of the digital construction project under the algorithm in this article are approaching the ideal digital construction project.
authors_display: Xiaoyi Liu, Yufeng Chen

title: Chinese Spoken Language Training System Based on Human-Computer Interaction Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of China and the continuous improvement of its global status, Chinese has attracted wide attention in the world. However, at present, China is still facing many problems, mainly manifested as: the students' enthusiasm is not high, the effect is not ideal. In this context, how to effectively promote students' learning efficiency in classroom teaching has been an urgent problem to be solved. In view of the problems of passive learning and participation consciousness in oral Chinese teaching, this paper designs a set of intelligent speech teaching platform with speech recognition, speech synthesis, natural language processing and natural language production as the core. The experiment has proved that the application of human-computer interaction technology in oral Chinese can mobilize students' enthusiasm for learning, enhance their enthusiasm for Chinese learning, and improve their oral English level.
authors_display: Aysigul Abduwali, Patime Ghoji, Maysigul Husiyin

title: Sharing Economy Model Based on Intelligent Data Analysis
abstract: How to further improve the efficiency and sustainability of the sharing economy is a thorny question. Many platforms are beginning to adopt methods based on intelligent data analysis, and this study aims to explore the advantages of the sharing economy model based on intelligent data analysis in terms of transaction efficiency. This paper adopts the methods of literature review and case analysis, collects and analyzes relevant literature and actual cases of sharing economy platform, studies the sharing economy model based on intelligent data analysis, and uses intelligent data analysis technology to describe the construction of sharing economy platform, and optimizes the selection of data sets. The research results show that the income growth rate of residents under the sharing economy model in this paper is between 10% and 20%, and the sharing economy model based on intelligent data analysis has obvious advantages over the traditional model in terms of transaction efficiency.
authors_display: Juqiang Li, Ling Yang, Qianqian Qin

title: Media Communication Marketing Data Analysis Based on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence technology benefits the field of marketing. Based on artificial intelligence technology, media communication marketing has enriched marketing means and adopted virtual endorsers for marketing publicity. From the perspective of virtual endorsers interaction, this paper studies the impact of virtual endorsers interaction on consumers' brand attitude, conducts empirical analysis through situational experiments and explores the internal mechanism, and finds that: (1) Product involvement moderates the impact of "whether virtual endorsers interact with people" on consumers' brand attitudes. For products with high involvement, virtual endorsers have a significant positive impact on consumer brand attitudes when interacting with people. For low-involvement products, "whether virtual endorsers interact with people" has no significant impact on consumers' brand attitudes; (2) Self-identity plays a mediating role in this regulation. This paper verifies the feasibility of the application of artificial intelligence in media communication marketing to a certain extent, which will help to enrich the related research of virtual spokesmen. At the same time, it provides suggestions and references for enterprise marketing practice.
authors_display: Guangkuo Hu, Rongting Luo

title: Study on the Relaxation Time Characteristics of Brain Tissue Based on Multi-Parametric Quantitative Magnetic Resonance Imaging
abstract: Traditional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is qualitative imaging, and doctors need to rely on experience to diagnose diseases, which cannot meet the current needs of precision medicine. As a new quantitative magnetic resonance imaging technology, magnetic resonance fingerprint imaging can obtain a variety of human tissue parameters at the same time through a data acquisition, which greatly improves the imaging speed and improves the impact of noise on image quality. Several pattern matching algorithms are compared, including direct matching method, Bloch response iterative projection method, covering tree and approximate nearest neighbor search method, and improved methods. Absolute error image, mean absolute error (MAE), normalized root means square error (RMSE) and running time are counted in the experimental results. The results show that the improved method is better than the traditional method, which can greatly improve the quality of MR fingerprint multi-parameter images (T1, T2, B0, PD), and make the running time within an acceptable range. In addition, the improved algorithm is insensitive to random additive noise.
authors_display: Jianhui Ren, Yuqin Zhang

title: Financial Optimization Budget Allocation Model Based On Big Data and Data-Driven Technology
abstract: The research on financial planning and budget management methods using big data technology is mainly based on the limitations of traditional financial planning and budget management in processing large amounts of data, real-time analysis, and prediction accuracy. By integrating big data technology, financial planning and budget management can become more dynamic and adaptable. This can enable enterprises to analyze historical data and market trends, and more accurately formulate financial budgets to make the most timely decisions. Through experimental data, it can be concluded that the use in financial planning and budget management can significantly improve the financial efficiency and decision-making quality of enterprises. It can be seen that the budget management effect of the financial planning and budget management system with the addition in the manual review process increased from 53.41% to a maximum of 128.30%, and most of the data was above 114.76%. The accuracy rate of the system's testing plan, improvement success rate, and completely infeasible judgment accuracy were all above 98.35%. It is not difficult to find that enterprises can optimize budget allocation through data-driven methods, better understand market and customer needs, and achieve revenue growth and cost savings, ultimately improving their competitiveness.
authors_display: Youfang Zhang

title: Research on Precision Marketing of E-commerce Enterprise Based on Cluster Analysis in the Big Data Environment
abstract: With the rapid development of big data technology, e-commerce enterprises have accumulated a large amount of user data in marketing activities. How to use these data for precision marketing, improve marketing effectiveness and reduce costs has become an important issue for e-commerce enterprises. In this paper, based on the K-means algorithm of clustering analysis, the basic information of 4026 effective customers is extracted according to the four indicators of purchase times, consumption amount, browsing times and praise times, and the customers are divided into core customers, maintenance customers, development customers, potential customers, and the corresponding precision marketing strategies are given. Targeting core customers, we can provide exclusive design and customization services; Targeting development-oriented customers, we can provide them with matching suggestions and inspiration; Targeting maintenance-oriented customers, we can increase the recommendation of coupons and promotional activities; Targeting potential customers can increase their understanding of the company and products
authors_display: Chun Hu, Chuanjian Wu, Zongjie Huang

title: Enhancing Soft Foundation Load Preloading Design through Intelligent Methods and Finite Element Technology
abstract: In order to manage the engineering costs associated with plastic drainage board plus vacuum combined load preloading foundation treatment technology and expedite construction timelines, this study employs a theoretical analysis method, integrating finite element technology and the particle swarm algorithm. A plastic drainage board plus vacuum combined load preloading technology is established, intelligently optimizing the design method and applying it to a practical project. The research findings indicate that finite element technology can accurately simulate the consolidation process related to the plastic drainage board plus vacuum combined load preloading foundation treatment, yielding calculated results consistent with actual measurements. Through optimization using the established method, the construction period for foundation treatment using the plastic drainage board plus vacuum combined load preloading approach can be significantly reduced, surface settlement effectively controlled, and project implementation costs reduced. The intelligent optimization design method proposed in this study is recommended for promotion and application in subsequent projects.
authors_display: Yuan Jiang, Kaiqiang Liu, Qi Huang

title: Research on Visual Design of Industrial Product Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
abstract: In the context of the upgrading of China's manufacturing industry, the design of industrial products is particularly important. Deep learning can be involved in automotive design activities through a variety of functions. We can use deep learning technology to design the appearance of cars through steps such as establishing a database, extracting feature values, drawing three-dimensional curves, unifying model dimensions, and analyzing errors. In this paper, the appropriate deep learning algorithm is selected through experiments to build a car image generation model based on StyleGAN2. The car image is generated by StyleGAN2 to achieve the purpose of designing car styling, and the full label database and the generation model are combined to form a car styling design tool based on deep learning, and the usability of the tool is tested through actual use. The new tool uses StyleGAN2 to generate car images for the purpose of designing car styling. The conclusion is that the function of artificial intelligence assisting designers to design automobile styling can be realized, which provides a new path for the styling research and development of other products.
authors_display: Chen Li

title: Real Time Congestion Control and Simulation of Large-Scale Video Conference System Based on GRU Algorithm
abstract: The comprehensive performance and user experience of large-scale distributed video conference systems are constrained by network traffic, and conventional network services are difficult to ensure the stability and reliability of the above data transmission activities. This article combines conference video transmission and congestion control related technologies to propose a conference video traffic prediction model based on the large neural network GRU algorithm, and constructs a large-scale distributed video conference transmission congestion control mode on this basis. The simulation experiments on the real-time congestion control model of research results show that it effectively avoids system fluctuations and significantly improves the user experience, providing a feasible method for improving the comprehensive performance of large-scale distributed video conference systems.
authors_display: Yuanfeng Wang

title: Application Exploration of Visual Recognition Technology Based on Deep Learning Algorithm in Website Development
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the amount of information we face is becoming more and more enormous. Traditional recognition methods have been unable to meet the needs of acquiring image content quickly and effectively. In this Internet age, developing websites is an essential job. From the perspective of deep learning algorithm, this paper studies and discusses a system based on deep neural network model, which aims to meet the user's personalized demand feature extraction. Through this system, the compatibility of users in different browsers can be obtained in real time, and the characteristics of images can be analyzed according to this information. This performance was then tested and analyzed, and the results showed that Chrome performed well in terms of compatibility, achieving the highest score of 9 out of all browsers. It was followed by Firefox and Safari, which scored 8 and 7 points, respectively. However, Edge and Opera had low compatibility scores of just 6 and 5, placing them at the bottom of the list.
authors_display: Huixin Zhu

title: Intelligent Signal Optimization Algorithm Based on Artificial Intelligence in Intelligent Traffic Control Systems
abstract: The acceleration of urbanization and the widespread use of motor vehicles in daily life have made the problem of traffic congestion in cities increasingly serious. Therefore, the importance of intelligent traffic control systems in traffic control and other aspects is becoming increasingly prominent. The intelligent traffic control system optimizes signal control strategies to promote the rational allocation of road resources and improve the efficiency of vehicle traffic operation on the road. This article studies three typical artificial intelligence based intelligent signal optimization algorithms, including neural network models, genetic algorithm models, and hybrid optimization algorithm models. The performance and effectiveness of these algorithms were evaluated through comparison and parameter analysis. The experimental data comes from actual traffic sensors and cameras collecting traffic data. The experimental results show that under the hybrid optimization algorithm model, the road occupancy rate can be reduced by about 2%, which means it has advantages in convergence speed and optimization accuracy, and is suitable for handling complex traffic signal optimization problems. In addition, this article also analyzed the impact of key parameters on the optimization results of the final experiment, and discussed the implications of the experimental results for the future development of the system and its limitations. This study provides valuable reference for the design of intelligent signal optimization algorithms in intelligent traffic control systems, which helps to achieve more efficient and accurate intelligent traffic control.
authors_display: Yu Zheng

title: Secure Sharing Method of Carbon GSP Business Database Based on Digital Signature
abstract: Authentication technology based on digital signatures realizes the secure transmission of data by sharing, unified storage and centralized management of information among multiple users. This study uses the carbon trading platform as the background to construct a data security system. The system generates new ciphertext from the public key generated during the original transmission process by applying data encryption technology combined with key distribution methods. At the same time, the encrypted file is distributed to the database server for processing using the data signature command, and the result is returned to the server. The system can also effectively protect the database from threats such as malicious attacks, thereby improving information security and trustworthiness. After that, this article conducts related basic performance tests on the system. Test results show that the platform's intrusion detection trigger rate is between 90% and 98%, the defense system's defense capability is between 91% and 98%, and the database response time ranges from 2 seconds to 6 seconds, and the data processing time ranges from 3 seconds to 6 seconds. This shows that the database has a relatively high security factor and can quickly respond to data processing commands. This research will help promote the development of carbon trading-related businesses based on digital signature platforms.
authors_display: Huafeng Zhang, Lei Zhang, Bingling Gu, Lin Tian, Fei Zhang

title: Cloud Computing Based Digital Media Content Distribution Technology
abstract: The rapid development of digital media content and the increasing demand of users for high-quality content have made digital media content distribution technology more and more important in practical applications. Cloud computing, as an infrastructure, has the advantages of flexible scalability and high quality for storage, management and distribution of digital media content. However, more in-depth research is needed to understand the impact of content distribution strategies under different network environments and media types. In this paper, based on the cloud computing platform, a series of comparative experiments were designed to evaluate the performance of cloud computing based digital media content distribution technology from different aspects. Factors considered in this paper included different network types, bandwidth, latency, packet loss rate, media types (video, audio, image) and distribution strategies. The experimental data is collected and analyzed, and the key indicators such as download time and playback success rate are evaluated. After analyzing the experimental results, we find that the performance of digital media content distribution is significantly affected by different network environments and media types. Cloud computing based content distribution strategies have been proved to achieve the effect of fast download and high success playback rate. The response time of cloud based distribution strategies is up to 4.7 seconds, and the bandwidth utilization rate reaches 89%, and the minimum latency is 104 ms. Under the same conditions, the performance of cloud computing is generally better than that of Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Peer-to-Peer (P2P). This study is a comprehensive experimental study of cloud computing based digital media content distribution technology. It has in-depth understanding of the performance of network environment, media types and distribution strategies. These research results have important reference and guidance to optimize digital media content distribution technology and improve the user experience.
authors_display: Xuguang He, Qing Zhang

title: Intelligent Information Processing Technology for Digital Libraries Based on Deep Learning
abstract: In the digital age, digital libraries have become an important channel for people to acquire knowledge and information. However, due to the vast amount and diverse types of information in digital libraries, traditional information processing methods are no longer able to meet user needs. This study aims to explore the intelligent information processing technology of digital libraries based on deep learning and propose effective methods. Firstly, it collects a large amount of digital library data, including various types of information such as text and audio. Next, the paper uses deep learning models to train these data and extract useful features and patterns. During the training process, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of information processing. Through experiments and analysis, it was found that intelligent information processing technology based on deep learning has significant advantages in digital libraries. It can automatically recognize and classify different types of information, extract keywords and topics, and complete tasks such as information summarization and recommendation. In addition, deep learning models can continuously optimize and improve information processing performance through learning and knowledge transfer.
authors_display: Lichun Wang, Xiangning Yu

title: 3D Printing Automation Control System Based on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: With the growth of personalized demand and the development of Industry 4.0, the limitations of traditional printing technology are increasingly prominent, and people's requirements for printing quality are constantly improving. In this study, the existing 3D printing control system is first studied, and then an AI control system based on DNN is designed and implemented. The system can optimize printing parameters by learning historical printing data, and automatically adjust the printing process to improve printing quality and resource utilization. The experimental results show that the printing speed of the automatic control system of 3D printing based on DNN can reach 297 cm/s, the surface roughness can be as low as 2μm, and the resource utilization rate can reach 88%, which significantly reduces the energy consumption and material waste in the printing process, and improves the surface quality and structural integrity of printed materials.
authors_display: Shui Liu, Jiao Huang

title: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis System of Electrical Equipment Based on Neural Network Algorithm
abstract: With the progress of electrical equipment, various faults often occur during its operation, which adversely affect the efficiency and quality of power supply. In this paper, the neural network algorithm is used to detect the system parameters. This paper first discusses the shortcomings and defects of traditional diagnosis methods, and then proposes a new method combining with existing technologies to build fault state identification criteria and classifiers based on neural network model, and also uses a variety of intelligent algorithms such as fuzzy reasoning and support vector machine to solve the common short-circuit problem of electrical equipment on the power line, so as to provide reliable security for actual operation and help the power sector. The performance of the diagnostic system is tested in this paper. The test results show that in the process of real-time monitoring, analysis and feedback processing of the fault identification system, the fault detection time is 5.2, 5.1, 4.9, 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4.4, 4.3, 4.2, 4.1 seconds by applying the neural network algorithm. This data represents a significant improvement in fault detection speed, from 5.2 seconds to 4.1 seconds.
authors_display: Chuanjun Zhang, Chunfang Zhang

title: Decision Analysis Method Integrating EWM and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
abstract: The main work of this paper: put forward the project of 'cutting off the ligament of illegal trade'; establish a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model to select customers for the project; the EWM-grey correlation analysis model is established to explain the suitability of the project and the impact and expected benefits of the project are analyzed and explained. Before the establishment of the model, we first introduced the project: cutting off the ligaments of illegal trade. we first collected and visualized relevant trade data and wild animal and plant quantity data. Next, the entropy weight method (EWM) is used to solve the weights of each indicator, which are 0.33,0.35 and 0.32, respectively. Finally, after obtaining the weights through the subjective weighting method and the objective weighting method, the optimal weights are obtained by the comprehensive integration weighting method, and the optimal weights are substituted into the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model to calculate the final score. According to the score, the selected target customers are: national wildlife management agencies. Finally, we established a decision tree model to explain the suitability of the project. The conclusion is that the technical strength of our project has the greatest impact on customer income. And our projects can have a positive beneficial impact on customers.
authors_display: Yanpeng Cao, Yifan Wang, Yuting Li

title: Refined Management Method for Engineering Cost Combining Artificial Intelligence Technology
abstract: How to address the obstacles of efficiency and cost control within project cost management? These limitations would be an issue because they are not suitable for the refined management requirements and would increase the amount of labor for the personnel. In this investigation, artificial intelligence (AI) was applied to improve the efficient and accurate refined amount in the cost management, for engineering, based on the refined construction cost information. Therefore, a significant amount of data of the construction engineering project was acquired. Key moments were the data cleaning, data preprocessing and data quality improvement. Furthermore, the machine learning algorithm was utilized to formulate the refined cost prediction model. For identifying the cost trend and probably other rules, the data mining technology was adopted. The cost model was further optimized by using the linear regression method in order to support the risk management and decision-making. The results of this study showed that the achievement for the refined construction amount of this paper was 93% to 98%. The application of AI in the refined amount of engineering cost management was able to significantly improve the cost prediction, and the refined cost control of engineering in the expeditious and accurate model.
authors_display: Xiaoyan Liu

title: Multi-objective Optimization of Shared Logistics and Express Delivery Platforms: an Algorithm Framework for Balancing Cost, Time, and Resource Utilization
abstract: In the booming development of network and e-commerce, emerging logistics models such as shared logistics and express delivery platforms have attracted widespread attention. However, this model poses significant challenges in cost control, delivery time, and resource utilization efficiency. In the design of path planning and scheduling algorithms, map data can be integrated, including road network, traffic flow, and other information. Taking into account factors such as road conditions and traffic congestion, heuristic algorithms such as genetic algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm can be used to calculate the optimal route. When optimizing resource allocation, a real-time data collection system can be built to monitor order quantity, vehicle location, etc. Based on real-time monitoring data, route planning and resource allocation strategies can be dynamically adjusted to cope with unexpected events and order changes. Based on feedback information, the algorithm architecture can be continuously improved to enhance its adaptability. The average cost reduction rate for regular packages is 12%, the average delivery time is reduced by 18%, and the average resource utilization rate is increased by 14%. This article helps to balance costs, shorten time, and improve resource utilization.
authors_display: Lei Wang, Zhen Feng

title: Exploration of Brand Visual Communication Innovation Design Method Based on AIGC Technology
abstract: This paper discusses the innovative application and challenges of generative artificial intelligence technology (AIGC) in brand visual communication and creative design of advertisements. AIGC has subverted the traditional communication method by virtue of its high efficiency and intelligence, realizing personalized customization and precise push ads, effectively improving the conversion effect and saving costs, and enhancing the brand's rapid response to the market and the efficiency of creative output. At the same time, this technology can promote the digitalization and intelligence of the advertising industry by tapping into big data resources. Accompanied by issues such as data security, privacy protection, talent shortage, creative quality control, brand image maintenance and regulatory adaptability, the industry needs to strengthen data security protection, cultivate cross-discipline AIGC technology and design talents, and establish a rigorous content audit system, so as to inject a strong impetus for brand visual innovation and design, and lead the brand visual communication and advertising creative design into a new stage of AI empowerment.
authors_display: Tiantian Chen, Bingnan Pang, Chuhua Ma, Wenwen Shao

title: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Logistics Control Platform Based on Spring Cloud
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology, Internet technology, management concepts and service models have also undergone earth-shaking changes. To address this challenge, this article proposes a solution based on a Spring Cloud application. The platform adopts microservice structure to realize efficient data interactive processing system architecture, mainly including administrator users, logistics personnel, front-end application software development environment, server and other functional modules. Its core goal is to help internal employees quickly and accurately access the company's website, and carry out statistical analysis of various reports to improve work efficiency and quality. After that, the intelligent logistics control platform was tested, and the test results showed that the security range was from 85 to 100, and at time point 8, the safety score reached the highest 99%, and the system security reached the best level. This shows that the background support management function can ensure the security of database information and record various operation logs to meet the management needs of enterprises.
authors_display: Changjuan Guo, Xiongwei Shi, Minmin Ji, Xuecui Ding, Bo Chen

title: Commercial New Media Advertising Recommendation Algorithm Based on Data Analysis
abstract: With the rise of new media, people's understanding of advertising has also changed. Traditional advertising methods are difficult to attract people's attention, and the information conveyed by commercial advertising is becoming increasingly diverse. In the new media environment, users must rely on various media to have a more comprehensive understanding of advertising. The development of commercial advertising relies on various new media. New media is a new carrier and channel that creates conditions for the leapfrog development of advertising. Consumers can only have a more comprehensive understanding of an advertising brand through the joint integration of multiple media. Therefore, in the context of new media, based on consumer awareness and consumption habits of advertising, it is necessary to improve the efficiency of advertising design and dissemination, in order to better meet consumer needs. The commercial new media advertising recommendation technology based on CF (collaborative filtering) algorithm has great potential and advantages. Through personalized recommendations, the click through rate and conversion rate of advertisements can be improved, bringing better advertising effects to enterprises. In the future, with the continuous development of data mining and artificial intelligence technology, advertising recommendation technology based on collaborative filtering algorithms would be further improved and applied, bringing greater development space for commercial new media advertising. The experimental results showed that after implementing the recommendation algorithm, the attention level of the advertisement was above 0.7, and the click through rate was as high as 0.8 or above. Due to the high accuracy and personalization of recommendation algorithms, the advertisements seen by users are more in line with their interests and needs, thereby increasing their attention and click through rate towards advertisements.
authors_display: Yongkang Zhang, Sihan Fu

title: Simulation and Implementation of Intelligent Network Technology System Based on Big Data
abstract: In today's society, big data and intelligent networks are important development trends in science and technology. With the rapid development of big data, higher requirements have been put forward for data processing and analysis, especially in the design and implementation of network technology systems. In response to the above issues, this article intends to simulate and implement the intelligent networking technology system in the big data environment. Based on big data, the article can identify and analyze the laws and trends contained in it by collecting and processing a large amount of Internet data and using data mining methods. This article can adopt a series of machine learning methods and apply them to network traffic prediction and network security improvement. This method can monitor the real-time operation status of the network and predict possible network congestion and attack behaviors, in order to achieve rapid and automated management of the network. The system throughput fluctuates with slight changes in response time, but typically remains between 495 and 530 requests per second. The experiment shows that the method used in this article can effectively improve data processing speed, error detection rate, and system stability.
authors_display: Yuwei Ma

title: Structural Simulation and Optimization of Three-dimensional GIS Technology in Urban Planning
abstract: This study aimed to use 3D (three-dimensional) WebGIS technology to construct a visual and interactive urban planning auxiliary decision-making system, to achieve structural simulation and optimization of urban planning. Main achievements: This article summarized the relevant technologies and concepts of 3D WebGIS involved in the development of the system. The logical structure and functional modules of the system were formulated and the summary architecture of the auxiliary decision-making system was clarified. The functional modules of the system were designed in detail, including 3D spatial analysis, spatial measurement and noise affected areas. In terms of the noise impact area analysis module, compared to traditional analysis methods, the accuracy of this system has been improved by 8%. From the perspective of system analysis and design efficiency, the urban planning auxiliary decision-making system based on 3D WebGIS technology could effectively improve the scientific, refined and intelligent level of urban planning to a certain extent.
authors_display: Ke Ni, Jie Ma, Yueyuan Zhao

title: Metaverse Algorithm in Automated Management of Intelligent E-Commerce People and Goods Yards
abstract: The article mainly studies the Metaverse algorithm in the automated management of intelligent e-commerce people and goods yards, aiming to optimize the logistics operation and inventory management in the e-commerce people and goods yards through the Metaverse algorithm. The Metaverse algorithm based on the automated management of intelligent e-commerce people and goods yards refers to a method based on Metaverse scenarios to achieve intelligent logistics operations and inventory management with minimal investment in manpower, material resources, and financial resources. Finally, the article verifies the feasibility and superiority of the Metaverse algorithm through a practical application case. The research results show that the Metaverse algorithm can increase the efficiency of automated management of intelligent e-commerce people and goods to a maximum of 93%, which is 4.9% higher than the general management method. Therefore, it can be concluded that after optimizing the logistics operation and inventory management of the people and goods yard, the Yuanverse algorithm has improved the efficiency of logistics operation and inventory management level, and reduced logistics costs.
authors_display: Na Yang, Xin Sui

title: Automated Digital Processing and Analysis of Cultural Heritage Based on Machine Learning
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, digital resources are increasingly used in the field of cultural heritage. However, there is a large amount of manual and repetitive work in the digitalization process of cultural heritage, resulting in low digitization efficiency and poor quality. Therefore, how to use new technologies and new methods to improve the efficiency and quality of digital processing and analysis of cultural heritage has become an important issue currently faced. In view of the problems existing in the digital processing and analysis of cultural heritage, this article studies the automated processing and analysis method based on machine learning, builds a digital automated processing and analysis system for cultural heritage based on machine learning, and applies it to the Chinese Grotto Temple protection and utilization project, achieving good results. By comparing with the traditional automatic digital processing method of cultural heritage, the study found that the automatic digital processing method of cultural heritage based on machine learning had more advantages in processing efficiency and cost, but measures still needed to be implemented to improve the processing time. Moreover, the average error and deviation of the machine learning method during the processing were only 2.103 and 0.957, which were far lower than the traditional method.
authors_display: Feng Li

title: Intelligent Internet of Things Device Management Based On Edge Computing
abstract: This study emphasizes the use of edge computing framework to manage intelligent Internet of Things devices. This paper introduces the management system of intelligent iot devices centered on edge computing, including the outline of the basic structure, the significance of edge computing in instrument management, instrument registration and identification process, instrument condition supervision and governance, instrument security and confidentiality safeguards, and equipment setting adjustment and enhancement. The results show that the implementation of intelligent IoT device management technology centered on edge computing can effectively overcome the obstacles existing in the traditional IoT device governance. Advocate for further exploration and wide application of this method in the real world.
authors_display: Lin Mei, Man Guo, Qiang Li

title: Low-carbon Data Center Operation Strategy in Cloud Computing Environments
abstract: This paper takes Ali yun as a case, deeply discusses the importance and implementation path of low carbon operation strategy of data center in cloud computing environment, summarizes the current situation of data center energy consumption and its impact on environment, and points out the necessity of low carbon operation. The paper discusses in detail the specific design of low-carbon data center operation strategies, including infrastructure optimization, server hardware selection, virtual machine management, data storage and transmission optimization, and carbon footprint tracking and monitoring. The article also highlights the key role of establishing industry standards, certification systems, technical training, knowledge sharing, and policy support and incentives in promoting low-carbon operational strategies. The article emphasizes the importance of multi-party collaboration and joint efforts to achieve the green transformation of data centers and the sustainable development of the digital world.
authors_display: Haibin Zhao, Zepeng Li, Haitao Zhou

title: Research on Data Privacy and Security in the Green Internet of Things
abstract: This study introduces a robust framework for protecting data confidentiality and enhancing data integrity within the scope of the Ecological Internet of Things (IoT). In terms of protecting data confidentiality, the framework integrates practices such as encryption measures, hiding identity by anonymizing data, managing user access, verifying security credentials, and controlling digital identity; especially in ensuring the integrity and confidentiality during data collection and dissemination, protecting data obtained from sensors and secure encryption of transport data during storage and processing; and emphasizes the importance of selecting secure storage locations and implementing technologies that respect privacy during storage and computing. To enhance the integrity of data in the study advocates the use of methods such as access governance and identity authentication, using security protocols and firewall technology, detecting and combating system intrusions, and protecting and identifying malware. To ensure the security of data privacy, the framework also designs protective strategies, including identifying and correcting system vulnerabilities, ensuring the physical security of the hardware, and conducting ongoing security assessments and surveillance.
authors_display: Yuan Liu, Nan Zhou, Mengxue Zhou

title: Construction of High-Quality Sample Database and the Application of AI Engineering
abstract: In order to develop a high-quality database and utilize them in AI engineering, this study utilizes a range of technologies and protocols. When assembling a repository with excellent examples, it is necessary to analyze the example requirements to ensure the effectiveness and utility of the repository. This was followed by a selective collection and screening of examples to ensure those that were typically representative. Furthermore, detailed labeling and review of the examples were conducted to ensure its accuracy and reliability. To maintain the currency and lasting relevance of the repository, continuous management and updating are required. Reviewing the procedures outlined, this survey highlights the need for concise approaches and centralized supervision of the accumulation and management of repositories to ensure the creation of a rich database of high-quality examples to support AI engineering projects.
authors_display: Xinyan Wang, Li Di, Ying Zhu, Junyi Wang, ... Xing Li

title: Research on Video Sample Collection and Processing Methods Based on Artificial Intelligence Platform
abstract: This paper summarizes the video sample collection and processing methods based on artificial intelligence platform, focusing on video noise cancellation, content segmentation and classification, and feature extraction and representation techniques. The paper believes that the deep learning technology, especially the convolutional neural network, shows great potential in image recognition and video analysis, and effectively improves the level of automation and accuracy of video processing. This paper discusses the importance of building a large-scale and high-quality video sample library, and how to improve the processing efficiency and accuracy of video data through intelligent technology.
authors_display: An Hu, Qi Wang, Xiaoguang Xu, Yao Zhao, ... Lei Pei

title: Construction and Application of Cost Prediction Model Based on Multiple Linear Regression Analysis
abstract: Production cost forecasting is the key link to control the production cost of products, is an important step for enterprises to scientifically plan the future cost level and cost objectives, and is also the basis for enterprises to make scientific decisions. Taking women's clothing as an example, this paper introduces a simple and practical product production cost prediction method based on multiple linear regression mathematical model, describes the establishment process and prediction steps of multiple linear regression mathematical model in detail, and makes a prediction empirical research. It is found that the design difficulty and production volume are the key factors affecting the production cost of women's clothing, while the unit cost of raw materials and the man-hour required for production are not significant. The sample equation was fitted by the least square method, and the mathematical model was established, and the empirical analysis was carried out by SPSS22.0 software. The results show that the model has a high degree of fitting and forecasting ability, and provides a scientific and practical cost forecasting tool for enterprises.
authors_display: Liuyan Lin, Wei Jiang, Biao Chen, Jing Yu, Chenhong Zheng

title: System Fusion Based on WordNet Word Sense Disambiguation
abstract: In the realm of natural language processing (NLP), Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) is a crucial task, and WSD systems are used in many NLP applications. Systems built on WordNet (e.g., Lesk) have been witnessing encouraging progress in the domain of word sense disambiguation. Yet, the performance of WordNet based WSD systems may have limits when disambiguating polysemous words. The purpose of this research was to investigate the discrepancies between a systematic fusing approach of WordNet WSD and a single best performing system. In the experimental test, the fusing approach was used to disambiguate, and in the control test, a single best disambiguating system was used to disambiguate. The accuracies, recalls, and disambiguation times of two groups were compared after the two groups were tested by the same test dataset. The result of the experiment is that the performance accuracy and recall of the experimental group is better than that of the control group. The decision result of the multiple systems was fused to strengthen the performance accuracy and comprehensive of the system. At the disambiguation time, the experimental group showed a worthy disambiguation rate of disambiguation.
authors_display: Mengtao Duan, Tingyan Luan

title: Research on Construction Technology of Tunnel Assembly Inverted Arch Structure
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low construction efficiency, difficult construction quality control and inadequate maintenance of traditional cast-in-situ tunnel invert structure, a fabricated invert structure and its construction technology are proposed. Considering the stress characteristics of the tunnel invert structure and the lifting conditions for construction and hoisting, a block scheme for the fabricated invert and filling structure is proposed. Based on the Hushan Tunnel of Linzi Linyi Expressway, this paper introduces in detail the structural type, component division and fabrication, as well as the construction technology of component assembly and connection of the fabricated inverted arch.
authors_display: Lili Tao, Baoqun Wang, Deming Wang, Chuanmin Xu, ... Zhipeng Li

title: Intelligent Educational Information Resource Sharing Platform Based on Zope/Plone
abstract: In daily teaching, research, and learning, most teachers and students urgently need a convenient and fast tool software to establish teaching and learning websites. This article aims to build a low-cost, easy-to-use resource sharing platform based on Zope/Plone (Zope stands for Z Object Publishing Environment) for teachers from different disciplines in vocational colleges. This platform consists of teaching research knowledge management, BBS (Bulletin Board System) forum function, and other components. Platform administrators can easily maintain and upgrade the platform. This article tested the server using Apache Bench, and the test results showed that the combination of Apache Bench and Zope can complete 100000 requests in less than two minutes, resulting in high system efficiency.
authors_display: Junna Hou

title: Design of Moving Target Detection System Based on Planning Algorithm
abstract: In order to detect moving targets in real time, it is necessary to establish a moving target detection system(MTDS) that can accurately identify them. This is very important in fields such as monitoring systems, autonomous driving, and intelligent robots. In order to improve the performance of the moving target detection system, this article believes that planning algorithms can be used. Therefore, this article uses the planning algorithm and points out that the planning algorithm can well schedule the internal resources of the MTDS and make intelligent decisions. Finally, this article conducts verification through comparative experiments. The results show that the average detection accuracy of the system based on the planning algorithm is 93.21%, while the average detection accuracy of the conventional system is 89.58%. The obvious gap proves that the planning algorithm can indeed improve the performance of the MTDS to a certain extent.
authors_display: Hao Qian

title: Towards Intelligent Auditing: Exploring the Future of Artificial Intelligence in Auditing
abstract: Recent years have witnessed an increasingly broad application of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies such as speech recognition, computer vision, natural language processing, machine learning, algorithmic framework, cognitive computing, deep learning and neural networks in the field of auditing, producing a far-reaching impact on traditional audit work. However, the application of AI technologies in auditing practices is still in its infancy stage and further exploration and development are needed. Based on an in-depth investigation of AI-powered auditing practices, this paper proposes four innovative paths towards intelligent auditing in response to the key problems and challenges in practices, namely, audit procedure design, audit data processing, audit approach transformation and audit model exploration, with a view of achieving full coverage of intelligent auditing and making it standardized, normalized, popularized and practically effective. These innovations will effectively advance the improvement in auditing competencies and promote the high-quality development of audit work.
authors_display: Ling Huang, Dongbing Liu

title: Research on Data Cluster Analysis based on Intelligent Algorithm and Big Data Analysis
abstract: With the development of the times, computers have been continuously developed, and data analysis based on intelligent algorithms has been gradually applied. Big data analysis has become an indispensable part of various enterprises and institutions, which can help enterprises better analyze the market, optimize the overall resource allocation and decision-making efficiency, and promote the sustainable development of the overall enterprises and institutions. The purpose of this experiment is to use intelligent algorithm and big data analysis technology to cluster hotel data, so as to find the patterns and associations hidden in the data and provide decision support for the hotel industry.
authors_display: Bingqing Weng

title: Intelligent Motion Detection Software based on Efficient Spatiotemporal Graph Convolution Algorithm
abstract: Exercise and dietary habits are important ways to maintain human health, and many people hope to ensure their own physical health through reasonable exercise and maintenance methods. Sports health analysis algorithms serve this purpose, and most intelligent motion detection software is also designed based on this algorithm. This article suggested that the performance of this algorithm can be improved through efficient spatiotemporal graph convolution, which enhanced its ability to collect data from various sources, analyze user physical conditions and exercise habits, and provide reasonable suggestions. This article also verified through comparative experiments that the motion health analysis algorithm based on efficient spatiotemporal graph convolution had stronger prediction accuracy than a single motion health analysis algorithm. The average prediction accuracy of these two algorithms was 92.93% and 84.81%, respectively. The experimental results fully demonstrated that the method proposed in this paper was very suitable for assisting in the construction of sports health analysis algorithms.
authors_display: Jia Sun

title: A Novel Method of Elderly Service Scheduling and Path Planning Based on Clustering Algorithm
abstract: Based on relevant research on the scheduling problem of home care appointments and path planning under time window constraints both domestically and internationally, this article considers the current situation of medical resource scarcity in the domestic home care industry and the characteristics of the home care industry that are different from general service industries. It proposes a clustering algorithm to study this problem and uses fuzzy time windows to describe customer needs under different task urgency. The practical results show that the proposed clustering algorithm can effectively analyze and solve the current development status and characteristics of the domestic home-based elderly care industry combined with a path planning scheme. Under the constraint of fuzzy time window, it studies the appointment scheduling problem under the conditions of determining service duration and fuzzy service duration, and finally proposes a solution method for the two types of problems, which has theoretical significance.
authors_display: Bing Yu, Xiangzhu Yan

title: Automatic Machine Translation Quality Evaluation Model under Feature Extraction Algorithm
abstract: How to efficiently evaluate machine translation is the focus of current research. Traditional translation evaluation methods have major shortcomings in evaluating translation quality. Therefore, it is necessary to study translation evaluation methods based on feature extraction. This topic builds a translation quality evaluation model based on image feature extraction algorithms. Then, deep learning technology is used to extract features from the image. By extracting features from translated texts, more and more accurate feature representations can be obtained, thereby improving the judgment level of translation quality. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this article can effectively improve the accuracy and BLEU of machine translation. To this end, this topic intends to study a translation quality assessment method based on feature extraction, thereby improving the accuracy of the translation quality assessment model.
authors_display: Wei Wu

title: Construction of Cross-cultural Ability Evaluation Model Based on Computer Network
abstract: In recent years, with the popularity of multimedia and Internet, people have integrated modern scientific and technological means such as computers and multimedia into foreign language teaching, providing students with a brand-new learning style and environment. This paper analyzes the advantages of cross-cultural communication based on computer network. The cross-cultural competence model of business English includes cross-cultural cognitive competence, cross-cultural strategy competence and cross-cultural action competence. In the evaluation of frequency and effective percentage under different score ranges, the frequency with a score range greater than 30 is 40, and the effective percentage is 0.5, which shows that the average students' cross-cultural ability is excellent. Cross-cultural communication of foreign languages based on computer network can provide a realistic cultural teaching environment for most students, and provide practical communication opportunities for most students, so that learners can use foreign languages to improve their overall language communication ability in the process of cross-cultural communication.
authors_display: Yun Lin

title: Expansion and Architecture of Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: Among various data processing tools, neural networks stand out prominently in the fields of computer vision, intelligent control, and brain-like computing. They emulate the operational processes of the human brain, constituting artificial neural networks. In the ongoing technological evolution, spiking networks have progressively captivated the attention of scholars across diverse disciplines. Integrating principles from neuroscience and artificial intelligence, these networks employ impulse signals for event-driven processing and utilize communication signals within the network, exhibiting a closer resemblance to the operational mode of the biological nervous system when compared to traditional neural networks. Pulses manifest as discrete signals, diverging from the generally continuous nature of input signals. Simultaneously, there exists limited comprehension regarding the brain's coding stimulus and signal processing procedures, rendering the encoding of information into pulse signals a challenging task. Furthermore, while convolutional neural networks excel in image recognition, they suffer from the drawback of poor biological interpretability. To bolster the self-extraction capability of spiking neural networks, a pivotal focus lies in enhancing their sign extraction proficiency. Consequently, this paper proposes a hybrid structure for a spiking neural network, with experimental results demonstrating significant improvements in feature extraction compared to preceding neural network models.
authors_display: Yanxi Wei, Fenggang Yao, Yuru Kang

title: Artificial Intelligence Translator DeepL Translation Quality Control
abstract: With the advancement of language technology, artificial intelligence translators are also constantly developing. As an intelligent translator, the emergence of DeepL provides new opportunities for the development of human translation industry. Based on the theory of machine translation quality control, this article analyzed the translation quality control strategy of DeepL. By analyzing the performance of the designed source and target languages in the text input stage, the impact of part of speech tagging and syntactic analysis on translation quality in the text processing stage was evaluated. The machine translation quality evaluation method based on semantic similarity calculation was adopted to evaluate the translation quality of DeepL, and DeepL was compared and analyzed with other translators. This research found that DeepL translation performed well in terms of translation accuracy, fluency, and naturalness. The overall score of DeepL was 100, reaching 94.13.
authors_display: Li Linlin

title: Collaborative Governance Empowered by Digital Technology - Construction of Precision Intelligent Control and Early Warning Platform for Construction Solid Waste
abstract: With the continuous acceleration of China's urbanization process, construction solid waste, as an important component of urban solid waste, has caused pollution to the urban ecological environment to a certain extent through its utilization and disposal. The article established a precision intelligent control and early warning platform for construction solid waste, achieving precise supervision of the entire process of construction solid waste disposal, which is of great significance for promoting urban green development and improving urban ecological environment. The experimental results showed that the monitoring coverage rate of the intelligent control early warning platform based on digital technology reached up to 91.8%.
authors_display: Yi You, Boon Cheong Chew, Hua Fan

title: Network Information Big Data Analysis Platform Based on Deep Learning Technology
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the amount of information and data is constantly increasing, leading to higher and higher demands for network big data analysis platforms. This paper primarily delves into the application of deep learning technology in digital text classification. In this paper, a deep learning-based algorithm is introduced in detail. It outlines the method of extracting specific numerical eigenvectors from large-scale non-negative eigenattribute samples and converting them into machine-readable code. ased on the aforementioned methodology, an analysis platform is designed, and its basic performance is simulated and tested. The test results indicate that the platform's ability to process abnormal data in Round A is 80, Round B is 90, Round C is 70, Round D is 85, and Round E is 75. The exception handling capacity of each category is represented visually through a bar chart, where the height of the bar signifies the size of the exception handling capacity for that specific category.
authors_display: Kai Yan, Hao Gao

title: Motion Image Blur and Duplicate Data Removal Algorithms in Computer Vision Technology
abstract: With the development of image processing technology, computer vision technology has been widely applied in the field of motion training. How to effectively restore blurred images during motion training and achieve deduplication of motion training images has become a current research hotspot. However, traditional algorithms cannot effectively extract the blurred information in the overlapping areas. The article studied a motion training image blur deduplication algorithm based on visual sensing was studied. The algorithm first performed blur restoration on the input motion training image, and then used the KL (Kullback Leibler) transform to deduplicate the restored image. The results showed that the image blur deduplication method based on visual sensing had a maximum deduplication rate of 88.6%. The visual perception technology proposed in this paper has better results in motion training image processing, which can improve the clarity and visual quality of the image.
authors_display: Yahong Li, Kai Liu

title: Association Analysis Algorithm in Smart Medicine Health Big Data Visualization
abstract: This paper discusses the research progress of correlation analysis algorithms in visualization of smart medical and health big data. It first analyzes the main problems of current healthcare big data analysis, such as inefficiency in handling large-scale data, insufficient data privacy protection and poor algorithmic interpretability. Then, the relevant research results and shortcomings in the existing literature are reviewed, as well as the relevant policies of smart healthcare and health big data. The article proposes the use of Apriori correlation analysis algorithm to improve analysis efficiency, enhance data privacy protection, and improve the interpretability of the algorithm. Through precision and reliability experiments, the method performs well in processing large-scale medical data, and the visualization results are significant.The Apriori algorithm processes medical data with an accuracy of 92%, a recall rate of 89%, and an area under the ROC curve of 0.95, which indicates that it is efficient and reliable. The above research results provide a valuable reference direction for the future development of smart medical health data analysis.
authors_display: Chen Ding

title: Wearable Sports Rehabilitation Monitoring System Based on Big Data Technology
abstract: At present, the aging of the population and the increase of health problems caused by lifestyle, sports rehabilitation has become an important means to improve the quality of life and restore physical function. However, traditional rehabilitation methods often rely on rehabilitation centers or hospitals, which are not only costly, but also greatly reduce the efficiency and accessibility of rehabilitation due to time and space limitations. The rapid development of wearable technology and big data analysis technology provides the possibility for real-time, accurate and personalized rehabilitation monitoring. Therefore, this paper focuses on the architecture and design of wearable sports rehabilitation monitoring system based on big data technology, and explains in detail sensor data acquisition and processing analysis, cloud computing and data storage, as well as user interface and interaction design. Finally, the results of two groups of simulation experiments are as follows: the accuracy rate of sports rehabilitation data increases by 11.9%, and the rehabilitation effect increases by about 20.8% on average. Through long-term data collection, the system helps researchers and doctors better understand the complex dynamics of the rehabilitation process, providing a scientific basis for future rehabilitation methods.
authors_display: Huantong Xu

title: Design of Virtual Simulation Training System Based on Motion Capture Technology
abstract: Motion capture is an important technology in the field of virtual reality, which collects and analyzes human movements through various sensors and cameras, and converts them into digital data for computer processing and application. The development of motion capture technology has greatly promoted the development of technologies such as virtual reality, augmented reality, and human-computer interaction. It applies motion capture technology to the field of sports training, develops a virtual simulation training system, uses computer simulation to create a three-dimensional virtual world, and experiences it in virtual scenes through human body sensations, breaking away from relying solely on personal experience and entering a scientific and intelligent training era. This article is based on motion capture technology and designs a virtual simulation training system. The core work includes virtual reality perception interaction model, functional case design, and actual acquisition of martial arts difficult action image targets. Optical motion capture accuracy testing is also conducted. The research results provide a complete solution for virtual simulation training systems.
authors_display: Dong Jiang

title: Design of Abnormal Behavior Detection System Based on Multimodal Fusion
abstract: The application of intelligent video surveillance systems can reduce the workload of staff, save human resources, and timely handle abnormal situations, reducing losses. Abnormal behavior detection based on multimodal fusion is a key part of intelligent video surveillance systems and a hot research topic in the field of pattern recognition. Its application prospects are very broad. Firstly, the dual stream residual convolutional neural network was studied. Based on the convolutional neural network model, the dual stream convolutional neural network model and residual convolutional neural network model were studied; Then, research the overall solution and related technologies, based on the multimodal fusion process, and study techniques such as RGB images, optical flow images, and bone images; Finally, the Resnet34 model was used for training and simulation, and the simulation results showed that the Resnet34 model has superiority. Applying deep residual structures to dual stream CNN has better recognition performance.
authors_display: Xiaoting Niu, Guanghai Zheng

title: Design of Intelligent Advertising Recognition System Based on Intelligent Recommendation
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, intelligent recommendation system has become an indispensable part of people's daily life. It has not only greatly enhanced the technological experience, but also caused people to pay more and more attention to their surroundings. This paper first introduces an algorithm based on intelligent recommendation, which plays a key role in the process of web browsing; then, this paper designs an advertising recognition model through the study of feature extraction methods and combined with advertising, aiming to solve the above problems, and verifies the accuracy and practicability of the model to help improve the overall performance of the website, so as to maximize the value utilization rate of the intelligent recommendation system in the sales promotion work of merchants. The verification results show that the processing time of advertising recognition fluctuates sharply throughout the period, sometimes increasing rapidly and sometimes decreasing rapidly. The reason for this fluctuation may be caused by different amounts of advertising and data. At the fourth point in time, the processing time for AD recognition peaked at 6 seconds, indicating that the system needed to process more ads at that point in time. At 6:00, the processing time for AD recognition quickly drops to just 3 seconds, which means that the system is processing a smaller number of ads at this point in time.
authors_display: Chuanming Ma, Shu Xu, Mingming Zhang

title: Computer Localization Algorithms in Visual Recognition Software
abstract: The main research content of machine vision technology is to identify objects through computers, extract the features of objects, and then divide the categories of objects according to the feature value and threshold. Traditional visual recognition software has low recognition accuracy and low efficiency. This paper uses the application of computer positioning algorithm in machine vision and makes the motion target positioning analysis. It utilizes image segmentation and image matching techniques to extract moving targets from images. This article analyzes the data of traditional evaluation methods and computer positioning algorithms applied in accuracy, real-time performance, and different environmental factors. The study found that the application of computer positioning algorithm can improve the accuracy of visual recognition, and the highest accuracy can reach 95.7%. In addition, it can also improve the identification efficiency and applicability to the environment.
authors_display: Yuan Yuan

title: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence Technology to Construct an Online Learning Monitoring and Student Behavior Tracking Model
abstract: The study advocates an innovative approach to designing software design and development curricula, integrating real-time industry adjustments, project-centric learning, and an adaptive methodology facilitated by AI integration. The primary goal is to redefine the roles of educators, learners, and AI tools to cultivate collaborative learning environments. In the implementation phase, a meticulously crafted course outline, aligned with the outlined principles, is deployed, capturing every facet of students' learning experiences through real-time data collection. Rigorous comparative analyses will assess learning outcomes and the effectiveness of AI integration, with feedback mechanisms involving students, faculty, and industry professionals facilitating timely adjustments. This research contributes to the academic discourse on impactful teaching methodologies in software design and establishes a systematic framework for continual enhancement. Future research initiatives encompass delving into advanced AI tools, continual alignment with industry requirements, and embracing emerging technologies to expand the horizons of software design and development education.
authors_display: Jing Wang, Fengze Wang

title: Application of Neural Network Algorithm in Computer Geometry Modeling
abstract: Computer geometric graphics modeling refers to the restoration of the target graphics in the computer graphics environment, and the visual presentation of users, which has been applied in the fields of graphics, virtual reality and computer-aided design. However, the traditional modeling system has some problems, such as low precision and low efficiency, so this paper proposes to use the point cloud data to extract the geometric features of the target graph. In this paper, the Particle swarm optimization-Extreme learning machine (PSO-ELM) algorithm is proposed later, and its principle and operation process are analyzed, and then the algorithm is used to improve the performance of the modeling system. In the comparative experiment of modeling accuracy in this paper, the average modeling accuracy of the intelligent modeling system using the proposed method is 96.97%, while that of the basic system is 94.70%. It is not difficult to see that the experimental results fully reflect the improvement of the modeling accuracy of the modeling system brought by the method in this paper, which is helpful to the application of computer geometric graphics modeling system in practical work.
authors_display: Wenxuan Wu

title: Research and Application of Dynamic Tree Growth Cycle Prediction Technology Based on Transmission Channel Laser Point Cloud
abstract: Traditional methods have great limitations in terms of prediction accuracy and accuracy.
